grain: One user within one campaign over the entire released impression period.
numerator: Pairs with any impression labeled conversion=1, counted once per pair.
denominator: All observed user-campaign pairs in a frequency bin.
frequency: Number of recorded impressions for that user and campaign across the released log.
note: Descriptive association only. Log sampling means recorded frequency need not equal true frequency. 30-day forward conversion labels can repeat across impressions. This is not a count of distinct conversion events. Across pooled campaigns a user can occur more than once. Observed frequency can reflect activity after conversion; no causal direction is inferred.
